text.autoconfig.emibook.title: EMI Book
text.autoconfig.emibook.option.screenShi: Shifts screen in the right direction when EMI is active (simulates a recipe book behaviour).
text.autoconfig.emibook.option.disableEm: Shows EMI only in places of Recipe Book.
text.autoconfig.emibook.option.switchEff: Switches effect location from RIGHT to RIGHT_COMPRESSED when EMI is active.
text.autoconfig.emibook.option.independe: Makes EMI keybinds work even if it's not active.
